crossRefs.note: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house…
I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought…
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…

translations.web: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.
translations.bsb: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
translations.kjv: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
translations.asv: Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely.
